evidence: Carries the Consensus label and modifies signature cache hashing invariants and validation helper entry points in src/script/sigcache.{h,cpp} and src/script/interpreter.h.
rationale: Clarifies implicit signature-cache hashing requirements and adds defensive assertions against ambiguous cache commitments without addressing an active consensus vulnerability. The change hardens serialization assumptions inspired by an Elements cache issue, but does not fix an active bug in existing call sites.
